title: Peruvian Roasted Vegetables
description: A hearty and flavorful vegetarian dish inspired by Peruvian cuisine, featuring roasted vegetables and a hint of Peruvian spices.
instructions: Peel and chop the sweet potatoes into 1-inch cubes.
Peel and chop the red onions into wedges.
In a small bowl, mix together the Peruvian coriander, jjante chili flakes, and garlic.
Toss the sweet potatoes and red onions with olive oil, salt, and the spice mixture until they are evenly coated.
Spread the vegetables out in a single layer on a baking sheet.
Roast in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender and lightly browned.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro if desired.
